targets.rawSql:
SELECT hook_name, count() AS runs, round(sum(hook_duration_ms) / 1000, 1) AS total_s,
       round(avg(hook_duration_ms)) AS avg_ms
FROM cc.events WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'hook_execution_complete'
GROUP BY hook_name ORDER BY total_s DESC

panels.title: API latency by model
panels.description: Per model: time to first token (ttft_ms, streaming requests only) and total request time (duration_ms), median and 95th percentile.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model, count() AS requests,
       round(quantileIf(0.5)(ttft_ms, ttft_ms > 0)) AS ttft_p50_ms, round(quantileIf(0.95)(ttft_ms, ttft_ms > 0)) AS ttft_p95_ms,
       round(quantile(0.5)(duration_ms)) AS duration_p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms)) AS duration_p95_ms
FROM (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.skill_name AS skill, e.model AS model, e.ttft_ms AS ttft_ms, e.duration_ms AS duration_ms,
         multiIf(e.agent_id != '', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent), e.query_source IN ('sdk', 'main') OR startsWith(e.query_source, 'repl_main'), 'main', concat('aux:', e.query_source)) AS actor
  FROM cc.events AS e LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
  WHERE e.event = 'api_request'
)
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY model ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: Time to first token by day (p50 / p95)
panels.description: ttft_ms per day, all models; requests without ttft_ms are skipped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, round(quantile(0.5)(ttft_ms)) AS p50, round(quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms)) AS p95
FROM (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.skill_name AS skill, e.ttft_ms AS ttft_ms,
         multiIf(e.agent_id != '', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent), e.query_source IN ('sdk', 'main') OR startsWith(e.query_source, 'repl_main'), 'main', concat('aux:', e.query_source)) AS actor
  FROM cc.events AS e LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
  WHERE e.event = 'api_request' AND e.ttft_ms > 0
)
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Request duration by day (p50 / p95)
panels.description: duration_ms of API requests per day, all models.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, round(quantile(0.5)(duration_ms)) AS p50, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms)) AS p95
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tool duration and errors
panels.description: Per tool: calls, duration (avg / p50 / p95) and failed calls (success = false).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name, count() AS calls, round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms,
       round(quantile(0.5)(duration_ms)) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms)) AS p95_ms,
       countIf(NOT success) AS errors, round(100 * countIf(NOT success) / count(), 1) AS error_pct
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

panels.title: Tool errors by day
panels.description: Failed tool calls (success = false) per day and tool.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, tool_name, count() AS errors
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE NOT success AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time, tool_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent failed tool calls
panels.description: Latest 50 failed tool calls (no paths or commands shown).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts, tool_name, actor, project, session_id, duration_ms
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE NOT success AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
